map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Franklin, Hamilton and Morrow publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-20 03:01): mail returned 4,609 (state 4,310); early in person 15,126 (state 14,967); ballots sent 15,891 (state 15,437). Clermont (as of 2026-10-20 10:55): mail returned 5,181 (state 5,133); early in person 7,060 (state 6,842). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-19 18:15): early in person 16,384 (state 16,326). Franklin (as of 2026-10-20 00:12): mail returned 30,076 (state 29,061); early in person 33,807 (state 33,327); ballots sent 78,481 (state 77,404). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-19 20:48): early in person 25,197 (state 24,942). Morrow (as of 2026-10-19 16:46): mail returned 706 (state 704).
